HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction
  • To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
  • Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 31 December 2026

Job Description

Title SI Solutions - FIC Proxy Voting Analyst

Department Asset Management CAO

Location Dalian

Level: 2

About Fidelity International

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.

Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.

About Fidelity Dalian

Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. The office has continued to expand in recent years and now acts as the central service hub for the Asia Pacific region supporting multiple business functions including systems development and support, systems infrastructure support, retail operations, finance accounting services and investment administration & fund accounting.

Team Description

Asset Management CAO team is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management. The Investment Management Solutions team is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

About Your Role

As the SI Solutions - Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.

About You

The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
  • Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
  • Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
  • Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
  • Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
  • Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
  • Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
  • Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.

Experience And Qualifications Required

  • Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
  • Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
  • Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
  • Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
  • Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
  • Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
  • Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
  • A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
  • Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Job Summary

To pro-actively promote designated Retail Clients products and services and acquire new customers.

工作范畴：

主动推广指定的个人银行产品和服务及开发新客户。

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in sales promotions and activities to achieve/exceed defined sales targets;
  • Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
  • A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
  • Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;
  • To provide quality, efficient before and after sales services;
  • To prepare and consolidate accurate reports on sales activities;
  • Based on a “shared sense” of purpose and approach within CB;
  • Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 参与促销活动，完成或超额完成指定的销售目标；
  • 跟进销售机会，开发新客户；
  • 以周全、创新的方法使客户满意，提升竞争优势及业绩表现；
  • 主动销售银行其它产品和服务，确保达到年度销售业绩指标；
  • 提供高质量、高效的售前和售后服务；
  • 编写和维护有关销售活动的准确报告；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for Liquidity risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Credit Appraisal and Marketing Skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • College/diploma degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Strong personal integrity with zero disciplinary record in any previous job
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Presentable, good personality with good business etiquette

职位要求：

  • 大专及以上学历。
  • 一年以上金融或房贷或房产行业工作经验优先。
  • 有相关银行行业销售经验者优先
  • 了解银行产品、政策及经营策略。
  • 良好的信用评价与营销技能，对金融市场有敏锐触角。
  • 良好的个人诚信，无任何纪律处分纪录
  • 良好的沟通，表达及学习能力。
  • 优良的个性品质，勇于销售及解决业务过程中的问题。
  • Other than above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

  • Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employees who have passed the probation, failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的，将作为不胜任工作工作岗位的考核依据。

  • Before attend and pass the “CPBB Essentials” class, the employee should not perform any kind of business communication / engagement to customers.

对于还没有参与并通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的员工, 禁止跟客户有任何业务上的交流。

  • Please note that the job description above will be reviewed during the Job Objective setting every year, which may be amended and agreed where necessary by the employee and the line manager.

请注意以上本工作描述将于每年制定年度工作目标时予以审核，如有必要将由直属经理和员工予以修订并达成一致。

  • In this document, Chinese version shall prevail over English version.

本文件若中英文表述不符，应该以中文为准。

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Ensures that AML/CDD/Sanctions (Individual Business) risks relating to the country are effectively managed end to end in accordance with Group and local regulatory requirements.

Assures AML/CDD/Sanctions (Individual Business) risk management through oversight and testing of the related CSTs and ensures material risks are identified, assessed, mitigated, monitored and reported / escalated in accordance with the bank’s Risk Management Framework.

Drives/coordinates/monitors initiatives, projects and actions to ensure the Bank operates in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations, Group/Country policies and standards, for the prevention of money laundering.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • China WRB Individual CDD team is a unit within the COO family for performing due diligence on Customer Due Diligence before approval.
  • Individuals CDD team CDD analyst is responsible for client contact for existing to bank clients for completion of CDD activities. However, the team can assign or take support from Relationship Managers (RMs) for completion of CDD activities / related requirements for priority clients

Business

Processes

Perform account Opening KYC/CDD for high-risk rating clients and ETB clients’ Periodic/Trigger Review.

  • Unless advised otherwise by the client’s RM, who will contact the client and arrange documents on behalf of the Individual CDD Team, The Individual CDD analyst’s role is to:

  • Complete CDD related documentation and ensure completeness of CDD information for ETB and NTB clients before submission to the IQC team who will check the quality of the CDD information before approval
  • Ensure that the information and document retained as part of CDD can be retained in a manner that meets legal and regulatory requirement as well as CDD Procedures.
  • Responsible for implementation and continued compliance with relevant laws and regulations (including changing AML related regulations), policies, procedures and risk control requirements through application of consistent group practices
  • Directs and executes activity within Individual CDD team and optimize end to end overall Individual CDD related processes and practices
  • Ensures alignment, maintenance and updating of relevant systems as required to achieve required operational and regulatory outcomes

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other.   • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
  • Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
  • Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
  • Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
  • Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
  • Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
  • Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in people management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
  • Master’s degree in business administration preferred
  • Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Sectoral Experience: Candidates should demonstrate deep sector expertise and established client relationships in one or more of the following coverage areas relevant to the China onshore market:
  • Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT)
    • Proven track record advising TMT clients on M&A, equity capital markets (ECM), and strategic transactions, with strong connectivity to China's leading internet platforms, semiconductor, software, and new media companies
    • Deep understanding of the regulatory landscape governing China's technology sector, including data security, VIE structures, and cross-border listing considerations
  • Industrials
    • Experience covering China's advanced manufacturing, aerospace & defense, engineering, logistics, and industrial conglomerates, with a focus on domestic consolidation, outbound M&A, and capital raising mandates
    • Familiarity with China's industrial policy priorities, including "Made in China 2025," dual circulation strategy, and state-owned enterprise (SOE) reform
  • Financial Institutions Group (FIG)
    • Strong relationships with Chinese banks, insurance companies, asset managers, securities firms, and fintech players, with experience advising on capital optimization, M&A, and regulatory-driven transactions
    • Understanding of CBIRC/PBOC regulatory frameworks and their implications for FIG deal structuring and execution
  • Healthcare & Life Sciences
    • Coverage experience across pharmaceuticals, biotech, medical devices, CROs/CDMOs, and hospital groups, with a strong grasp of China's healthcare reform agenda and NMPA regulatory environment
    • Track record on healthcare IPOs, licensing deals, and cross-border partnerships involving Chinese and multinational healthcare companies
  • Natural Resources & Energy
    • Advisory experience in oil & gas, mining, metals, chemicals, and new energy (solar, wind, EV battery supply chain), with knowledge of China's energy transition policies and resource security strategy
    • Established relationships with major Chinese state-owned energy and resources enterprises (e.g., CNOOC, Sinopec, CNNC, Chinalco) as well as private sector players
  • Consumer & Retail
    • Deep sector knowledge across food & beverage, luxury goods, e-commerce, consumer staples, and lifestyle brands, with experience advising on brand acquisitions, retail consolidation, and cross-border consumer transactions
    • Understanding of evolving Chinese consumer trends, domestic brand emergence ("国潮"), and the competitive dynamics between domestic and international players
  • Additional Sector Considerations
    • Real Estate & Infrastructure: Experience with China's property developers, REITs, and infrastructure funds, navigating the post-deleveraging regulatory environment
    • Education & Government Services: Advisory background in the evolving regulatory landscape post-2021 sector restructuring
    • Automotive & New Energy Vehicles (NEV): Coverage of OEMs, EV supply chain, and smart mobility companies amid China's global NEV leadership push
  • 7+ years of China A-share sponsor-related experience in an investment banking front office role
  • Possess China sponsor representative license
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.

  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

  • Lead a China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, while also acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines people leadership with significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Allocate work, set priorities, review outputs and develop the capability of the local team. Ensure clear accountability, appropriate segregation of duties, adequate documentation and effective backup arrangements.
  • Drive improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is accountable for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
  • Developing and retaining a small local team capable of handling complex issues independently, while maintaining delivery quality during periods of change, pressure or increased business activity.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness

Other Skills

  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience leading complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

  • CICPA & CFA is preferred

- Stakeholder Management

The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
  • Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
  • Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
  • Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects


Recommended Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience
  • Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
  • Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
  • MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
  • Series 7 and 63 preferred


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

  • Engage in defining and optimizing investment banking quality control standard and framework, including policies and procedures, deal process and system
  • Review and assess investment banking transactions with respect to business selection and internal review standards and requirements
  • Perform QC review of the materials and documents submitted/filed/disclosed by deal teams to make sure the compliance with relevant rules and regulations, CSRC / stock exchange requirements and self-regulatory body rules
  • Monitor and assess whether the deal team have diligently performed due diligence duties
  • Perform necessary onsite inspection and issue explicit onsite inspection opinion when material risks are identified
  • Manage and supervise post-issuance continuous supervision and bond entrustment management responsibilities
  • Guide and review the deal teams to complete working paper archiving in accordance with relevant requirements
  • Carry out policy and regulation research and provide advice on transaction execution
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for firm’s reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practice, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications
  • Solid accounting, legal and financial knowledge, familiar with A-share investment banking transaction process

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Productivity Suite).


Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：58133

Location: Guangzhou


Why join us?

HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.

You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.


The Opportunity:

Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re growing our engineering capability in China and are looking for an experienced engineer to work as a senior technical contributor within one of our engineering pods.

As an Associate Director, Software Engineering, you’ll operate as an individual contributor, designing and delivering significant capabilities for HSBC Productivity Suite. You’ll take complex requirements from initial definition through coding, testing, release and production operation.

This is not a formal people-management role. You’ll spend most of your time on hands-on engineering while providing practical technical direction, removing delivery blockers and mentoring other engineers in the pod.


Principal responsibilities

  • Spend most of your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
  • Design and deliver significant generative AI capabilities and integrations, owning delivery from requirements through to production operation.
  • Act as a senior engineer within an engineering pod, making sound design decisions, clarifying ambiguity and breaking complex requirements into actionable deliveries.
  • Build secure, resilient and maintainable services, applying appropriate engineering controls across testing, deployment, monitoring, observability and production support.
  • Use and improve shared frameworks, platforms and reusable capabilities, giving constructive feedback and reducing duplication and technical debt.
  • Promote effective engineering practices, including the safe use of AI coding tools and agents to improve quality and delivery across the software development lifecycle.
  • Take an active role in production incidents, helping restore service, leading reviews and ensuring lessons result in practical improvements.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, design and code reviews, knowledge-sharing and practical support, while informing technical direction through evidence and engineering expertise.


Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience, with a record of designing, coding, testing and operating significant applications or product capabilities.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, with an interest in building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
  • Hands-on experience building AI, machine learning or generative AI solutions and taking them from experimentation into secure, reliable production use.
  • Practical knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
  • Sound engineering judgement across performance, security, resilience, maintainability, accessibility, technical debt and production operability.
  • Ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify the most important parts of a problem and deliver robust solutions with limited oversight.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly, challenge constructively and mentor engineers in a global team.


About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
